principles: temporary containment never claims to be a permanent fix
actively exploited systems require compromise assessment after patching
network-changing actions require explicit operator apply flag

items.action: Historical guidance only; obtain the current manufacturer advisory before action. Install all currently applicable Microsoft security updates for the deployed Windows release; reboot if required; then re-scan. This group includes the September exploited privilege-escalation issues plus earlier 2026 actively exploited Netlogon/IKE issues. Do not treat successful installation as proof that prior exploitation did not occur.
items.verify: No applicable security updates remain and installed OS build is at or above Microsoft fixed build for the deployed release.
items.review_note: Full current manufacturer remediation statement not established in this bounded review; historical guidance requires vendor confirmation.
items.exploitation_priority_basis: Preserve historical risk priority unless current manufacturer evidence explicitly updates it; not a fresh exploitation claim.

scope: Selected advisory review, not a complete current vulnerability feed or fleet compliance assessment.
source_scope: Vendor security advisories and release notes
CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities evidence where directly or government-source corroborated
Canadian Centre for Cyber Security alerts/advisories
GitHub Security Advisories for covered open-source projects
review_semantics: VERIFIED means only the stated manufacturer claim was checked; deployment applicability and later advisories remain external. UNKNOWN cannot produce PASS_FIXED.
cert_eu_coverage_scope: Historical September mapping only; not a newly verified CERT-EU inventory.
